ModBrowser Description: Browse, install and update mods from the Steam Workshop
NML_ModBrowser Description: Browse and install mods from the Steam Workshop
mod_browser_empty: No mods match the current filters.
mod_browser_select_hint: Select a mod to see its details.
mod_browser_error_steam_unavailable: Steam is not available. Start Steam and restart the game to browse the Workshop.
mod_browser_error_offline: You are offline. The Mod Browser needs a connection to Steam; installed mods keep working.
mod_browser_dependencies_unknown: Dependencies: listed in mod.json, known after install
mod_browser_warning_text:
Workshop mods are programs. An enabled mod runs with the same access to your computer as the game itself. NeoModLoader does not review or sandbox Workshop mods.

"Unverified" uploads come from authors who skipped NeoModLoader's community check. "Verified" only means the uploader passed that check, not that anyone reviewed the code.

The browser installs mods disabled. Only enable mods from authors you trust.
mod_browser_install_unverified_text:
"{0}" is an unverified upload: its author skipped NeoModLoader's community check.
It will be installed disabled. Install it?
mod_browser_download_all_text:
Install {0} mods (about {1})?
{2} of them are unverified uploads.

Installing subscribes your Steam account to each item. Mods are installed disabled unless you turn on the switch below, and nothing is loaded until you press Apply or restart the game.
mod_browser_nothing_to_download: Everything listed is already installed and up to date.
mod_browser_no_updates: All subscribed mods are up to date.
mod_browser_summary_missing_deps: Some installed mods have missing dependencies. Select one and use "Find deps".
mod_browser_apply_text:
Compile and load the {0} mods installed with "Enable after install" now?
This runs their code in this session.
mod_browser_uninstall_text: Unsubscribe from "{0}"? Steam removes its files. If it is loaded, it stays active until you restart the game.
mod_browser_deps_install_hint: Each item is checked after download; one that does not provide the required mod is removed again.
mod_browser_deps_none_found: None of the missing dependencies were found on the Workshop. Search for them manually.
mod_browser_detail_no_mod_json: No mod.json: this is not a NeoModLoader mod.
mod_browser_detail_bepinex: This is a BepInEx mod and needs BepInEx. NeoModLoader links it on the next start.
mod_browser_error_not_nml: Installed, but it is not a NeoModLoader mod (no mod.json).
mod_browser_error_wrong_dependency: This item provides {0}, not the required {1}, so it was removed again.
mod_browser_note_bepinex: BepInEx mod: NeoModLoader links it on the next start.
mod_browser_note_local_copy: Installed, but a local copy with the same ID in the Mods folder takes priority.
mod_browser_note_restart: Updated. Restart the game to use the new version.
mod_browser_note_apply: Marked as enabled. Press Apply or restart to load it.
mod_browser_detail_bepinex_disabled: BepInEx mod, disabled: NeoModLoader does not link it into BepInEx. An existing link is not removed.
mod_browser_note_bepinex_disabled: BepInEx mod installed disabled: it is not linked into BepInEx until you enable it.
